purpose: GISCOE candidate native-ID/completeness acceptance audit for Johannesburg-region city targets.

source.service: GISCOE South Africa Cadastre MapServer layer 1

objectIdsProfile.status: Not presently accepted for runtime: exact-ID object-ID/count manifests succeeded in batches but repeated one-query/15s provider timeout at Cosmo offset 200, and native identity conflict at Mboloko offset100. Size-3 retry also timed out at Cosmo offset200 and Mboloko offset30. A single-ID adapter read succeeded but took 24.5s end-to-end, exceeding the 15s gateway budget. Keep this profile held until a reliable smaller/faster exact-native profile is proven.

offsetProfile.status: Diagnostic only: for 3 IDs, one complete offset-paged adapter read returned exact matching geometries in 11.273s Cosmo City and 10.999s Mboloko; no transfer limit, 3 features, 0 absent. This profile is not full target validation; it lacks exact object-ID manifest and is incompatible with nativeGeometryMode=parts per adapter descriptor validation.

failedRequests.message: Parcel provider returned conflicting geometry for one parcel ID.

duplicateNativeIdentityFindings.partsModeRuntimeBudget: 22.719s one-key exact read; over the 15s app gateway budget
duplicateNativeIdentityFindings.canonicalIdentityConclusion: Part assembly is geometrically valid for this sampled key, but does not resolve all-target completeness or runtime budget.

otherCandidateFields.ParcelGuid: Cosmo 2 populated of 532; Mboloko 0 of 330; Ennerdale duplicated across same repeated SG21KEY pair. Exact ID query returned one Cosmo row for sampled populated value and two Ennerdale rows for repeated value; not suitable for all-city identity.
otherCandidateFields.GlobalID: Unique per sampled source row, but exact lookups returned 0 for tested IDs; not accepted as native key.
otherCandidateFields.SGSUBKEY: Unique across sampled Cosmo records; unique=143/210 Ennerdale with same-repeat pattern; unique across local Mboloko sample but duplicated globally in audited exact batch. Use as match field only in configured parts grouping, never canonical ID by itself.

duplicateGroups.partsModeRuntimeBudget: 22.719s one-key exact read; over the 15s app gateway budget
duplicateGroups.canonicalIdentityConclusion: Part assembly is geometrically valid for this sampled key, but does not resolve all-target completeness or runtime budget.

conclusion: GISCOE remains on technical hold for these targets. Ennerdale has overlapping repeated SG21KEYs. Mboloko’s audited duplicate is disjoint and the adapter’s parts mode assembled that one group with matching SG21KEY/SGSUBKEY, but all-target completeness timed out and one exact parts read took 22.719s, beyond the 15s app gateway budget. Cosmo exact native-ID validation is incomplete after repeated provider timeouts. Offset mode passed only 3-key diagnostics; it is not full native-ID acceptance and cannot be used with the parts descriptor.
